title: Higehiro: After Being Rejected, I Shaved and Took In a High School Runaway
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After being turned down by his boss Airi Gotou, 26-year-old office worker Yoshida meets Sayu, a teenage runaway who offers sex in exchange for a place to stay. He refuses but lets her live with him in exchange for chores, and slowly learns she ran from Hokkaido after a friend's suicide and a cold mother, surviving by sleeping with men. One Peace Books publishes the manga adaptation; rating to verify.
life_message: It holds up responsible adult care, without exploitation, as what helps a hurting young person return home.
